summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited furnished a Form 6-K reporting a fatal loss-of-life incident at its Mponeng mine in the West Rand, Gauteng, South Africa, following a seismic event on 14 September 2026. The affected underground working area has been suspended pending a thorough investigation, with the Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources and relevant stakeholders notified. No transaction, equity, shareholder or corporate-action terms were disclosed. Harmony expressed condolences and committed to strengthening safety controls and risk-management practices. The filing is an operational disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for production impact, regulatory scrutiny and potential ESG or safety-related investor reaction.
